organizations.name: GDG Yerevan
organizations.description: Davit has been organizing GDG Yerevan events since Google I/O Extended Yerevan 2022, helping grow the local software engineering and Google developer community through conferences, workshops, livestreams, and hands-on technical meetups.

community.positioning_summary: Davit is not only a senior backend and architecture-oriented engineer, but also an active technology community builder in Armenia. Since 2022, he has helped organize GDG Yerevan events ranging from Google I/O Extended and KotlinConf Global local editions to DevFest Armenia, Build with AI workshops, and Women Techmakers initiatives. His community work demonstrates leadership, communication, ownership, mentorship, and the ability to bring engineers, speakers, companies, and learners together around practical technology education.
